description: Broader terms (dog -> canine), narrower ones (dog -> poodle), parts, similar words and other WordNet relations of a word, per meaning. More APIs from FitzTopPicks: https://fitztoppicks.com/apis?utm_source=mcp-api&utm_medium=mcp&utm_campaign=more-apis

pos.description: Only this part of speech: noun, verb, adjective or adverb.

relation.description: Comma-separated, or "all": hypernyms (broader), hyponyms (narrower), similar, seeAlso, partOf, hasParts, memberOf, hasMembers, substanceOf, madeOf, entails, causes, attributes, topics, derived (word forms like teach → teacher), pertainyms. Default hypernyms,hyponyms,similar.

safe.description: Best-effort family-friendly filter (default false). Drops senses WordNet tags as vulgar, derogatory, slur or slang, senses whose definitions describe sexual, excretory or illegal-drug meanings, and a list of profane and slur words, everywhere in the answer. Not a guarantee;

word.description: A word or phrase (up to 64 characters; "ice cream", "run away"). Inflected forms are matched to their base form: ran → run, mice → mouse, dogs → dog.

name: related_words
title: Broader, narrower and related words
